To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a large collection of embryo-enhancing genes was isolated and preliminariy characterized, and that this set of genes may be useful for understanding the molecular mechanisms of early embryo development.

(1) a large set of embryo-enhanced clones was isolated using a subtracted-probe screening approach; (2) these genes were expressed in a variety different patterns during embryogenesis; (3) the expression of some genes was correlated with embryo developmental stages; (4) the expression of other genes was correlated with the expression of known embryo-enhanced genes, suggesting a possible role in the regulation of embryo development; and (5) a number of genes were identified that have homology to
a diverse set of genes from carrot somatic embryos has been isolated and characterized, and that these genes may serve to identify molecular markers for early stages of embryogenic development.

the identification of genes that are expressed during early embryogenesis and the characterization of their patterns of expression during embryo development.
identifying and characterizing genes that are differentially expressed during early embryo development.
the identification and characterization of molecular markers for early stages of embryonic development.

the use of subtractive hybridization to isolate embryo-enhanced genes from a somatic embryo system was effective.
the subtractive hybridization approach was useful for isolating a diverse group of genes that are expressed during early stages of carrot embryo development.
this study has isolated and characterized a large set of novel genes that are expressed in somatic embryos.

the carrot somatic embryo system is a powerful tool for the study of early plant embryogenesis and that the genes isolated and characterized here will be valuable for further analysis of the molecular mechanisms of embryogenesis.

the carrot somatic embryo system provides a powerful tool for the isolation and analysis of embryogenesis-specific genes.
